## Nano Banana Image Gen Automation

This automation generates images via 4 models on Fal AI.

Send `model` field in the webhook body to select:
- `nano_banana` → Nano Banana Pro ($0.15/img)
- `flux_kontext` → FLUX.1 Kontext Pro ($0.04/img)
- `gpt_image_2` → GPT Image 2 ($0.01–$0.41/img)
- `topaz` → Topaz Upscaler (~$0.05/MP)

All paths → Split Out → Download → Google Drive

## Nano Banana Pro
Async queue → poll every 120s
$0.15/image

## FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]
Async queue → poll every 60s
$0.04/image

## GPT Image 2
Synchronous — returns immediately
$0.01–$0.41/image (by quality + resolution)

## Topaz Upscaler
Synchronous — returns immediately
~$0.05/MP (scales with output resolution)

## Export + Delivery
Each lane has its own Split → Download → Upload to Google Drive
